stories.title: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case over rental listings
stories.summary: The FTC settled its antitrust case against Zillow and Redfin. The case involved the two companies' rental listings partnership. TechCrunch, The Verge, and Engadget reported the settlement on August 24.
stories.whyItMatters: The deal resolves regulatory scrutiny of a partnership between two dominant real estate listing platforms.

stories.title: Lenovo confirms Legion Go issues after gamers report bricked devices
stories.summary: Lenovo confirmed problems with its Legion Go handheld gaming devices. The confirmation follows reports from gamers that some units stopped working, per The Verge. The report does not specify the cause or the number of units affected.
stories.whyItMatters: Hardware failures on a flagship handheld raise questions about quality control in the fast-growing PC handheld gaming market.

stories.title: Data centers drive a US gas power expansion, Wired reports
stories.summary: Data center growth is pushing a large expansion of gas-fired power generation in the US, according to Wired. The report links rising electricity demand from data centers to new gas plant construction.
stories.whyItMatters: The energy needs of AI and cloud infrastructure are reshaping US power generation and raising grid and climate concerns.
whatToWatch: Utility and regulator responses to the added demand
Whether renewable power capacity keeps pace with data center growth
questions: How much of the new gas capacity is directly tied to data centers versus other demand?

stories.title: Power transformers become a hot commodity as data centers scale up
stories.summary: Ars Technica reports that new power transformer technology is becoming a "killer application" for data centers. Operators are racing to secure the electrical hardware needed to support their growth.
stories.whyItMatters: Transformer supply is emerging as a bottleneck for data center and AI infrastructure buildout, which can slow how fast companies expand capacity.
whatToWatch: Transformer manufacturing capacity and delivery lead times
Adoption of the newer transformer designs described in the report
questions: Which manufacturers are best positioned to meet the demand?

stories.summary: CD Projekt Red is aiming to release The Witcher 4 in 2028, according to Engadget and The Verge. The timeline points to a multi-year development cycle for the studio's next major title.
stories.whyItMatters: A firmer timeline gives the gaming industry a clearer view of CD Projekt Red's release pipeline after Cyberpunk 2077's troubled launch.

stories.title: Airbound raises $37M to challenge trucking with cargo drones

stories.whyItMatters: The study gives early data on how AI is reshaping hiring and career entry points, a key concern for workers and policymakers.
